mapper.select: SELECT l.agent_id FROM house_listing l JOIN property_unit u ON u.id = l.unit_id WHERE l.id = #{listingId} AND l.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND u.occupancy_status = 'VACANT'
SELECT id FROM conversation WHERE listing_id = #{listingId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation(id, listing_id, tenant_id, agent_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{listingId}, #{tenantId}, #{agentId}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.listing_id AS listingId, l.title AS listingTitle, CASE WHEN c.tenant_id = #{userId} THEN CAST(lt.id AS CHAR) ELSE CAST(tt.id AS CHAR) END AS peerId, CASE WHEN c.tenant_id = #{userId} THEN lt.nickname ELSE tt.nickname END AS peerName, c.last_message_preview AS lastMessagePreview, c.last_message_at AS lastMessageAt, 0 AS unreadCount FROM conversation c JOIN house_listing l ON l.id = c.listing_id JOIN sys_user tt ON tt.id = c.tenant_id JOIN sys_user lt ON lt.id = c.agent_id WHERE c.id = #{conversationId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation c WHERE ${ownerColumn} = #{userId} AND c.last_message_preview IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.last_message_preview) <> ''

SELECT c.id, c.listing_id AS listingId, l.title AS listingTitle, CASE WHEN c.tenant_id = #{userId} THEN CAST(lt.id AS CHAR) ELSE CAST(tt.id AS CHAR) END AS peerId, CASE WHEN c.tenant_id = #{userId} THEN lt.nickname ELSE tt.nickname END AS peerName, c.last_message_preview AS lastMessagePreview, c.last_message_at AS lastMessageAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.sender_id <> #{userId} AND m.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadCount FROM conversation c JOIN house_listing l ON l.id = c.listing_id JOIN sys_user tt ON tt.id = c.tenant_id JOIN sys_user lt ON lt.id = c.agent_id WHERE ${ownerColumn} = #{userId} AND c.last_message_preview IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.last_message_preview) <> '' ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC, c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET read_at = #{now} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND sender_id <> #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message(id, conversation_id, sender_id, message_type, content, created_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND (tenant_id = #{userId} OR agent_id = #{userId})
